Dublin Fiddler Tommie Potts plays 'My Love is in America'

Tommie Potts, particularly due to him being from Dublin which does not really have it's own fiddle styles, was unique. Unlike most traditional players before him, Potts was very influenced by jazz. His approach to the music was extraordinary as he played with rhythm a lot, often adding extra beats in places to dismantle the dance rhythm and his variations were more embellished. Potts performances were about creativity more than tradition and his style is one of a kind. Here is one of his own compositions, The Butterfly: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cNqqsAo48hQ

Edit: According to a few people on Youtube, it's not one of his compositions but a collection of pipe tunes which he heavily altered.
